records.canonicalDescription: As a reaction, you can make a Use the Force check after you or an ally within 12 squares misses with a melee or ranged attack, removing one use of the farseeing Force power from your active suite (as though you had activated the power). If your check result equals or exceeds the Will Defense of the target of that missed attack, the attacker can reroll the missed attack roll. This counts as using the farseeing Force power against that target, but this talent replaces the normal rules and effect of that power. Any attack can only be affected by this talent once (thus, multiple characters cannot use this talent on the same attack to allow multiple rerolls). You take a cumulative -5 penalty on Use the Force checks until the beginning of your next turn when you use this talent.

records.canonicalDescription:
As a standard action, you can spend a Force Point to create an illusion that seems perfectly real to anyone who views it. You designate the form and complexity of the illusion, as well as its size and location, and make a Use the Force check. When a creature views the illusion, compare the result of your Use the Force check to the creature's Will Defense; if your check result exceeds its Will Defense, it believes the illusion to be real. Any physical interaction with the illusion (such as touching it, passing through it, or shooting it with a blaster) immediately reveals the true nature of the illusion, and the creature is no longer deceived. The illusion lasts for a number of minutes equal to your heroic level.

The illusion’s size also affects your Use the Force check, applying a penalty for exceptionally large illusions. The penalties are -1 for Huge illusions, -2 for Gargantuan illusions, -5 for Colossal illusions, and ~10 for Colossal (frigate) or larger illusions.

This is a mind-affecting effect.

records.canonicalDescription: You form an enhanced telepathic link with a willing ally with the Force Sensitivity feat as a swift action. The link is maintained until you choose to remove it (no action required). As long as you remain within one kilometer or your target, you and the target can communicate telepathically as though you were speaking. Once per encounter, you may use a Force power from your target’s Force suite (if the target consents), or you may allow the target to use one of your Force powers. You may only have one telepathic link active at a time.
records.quickSummary: You form an enhanced telepathic link with a willing ally with the Force Sensitivity feat as a swift action.
records.repoBenefit: Establish a Use the Force link within 1 km to communicate as if speaking; once per encounter, may share a Force power between you and the linked ally.
records.repoDescription: Communicate telepathically with an ally within 1 km once per encounter.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Control|Beast Trick
records.canonicalTreeKey: Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Control
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You can use the mind trick Force power on creatures of Intelligence 2 and lower. However, a beast with an Intelligence of 2 or less still cannot perform any complex action or understand complex commands it wouldn't otherwise be able to understand; an affected beast might understand “Attack those Sith troopers!” but it would not comprehend, “Break into the command center and disable the communications array."
records.quickSummary: You can use the mind trick Force power on creatures of Intelligence 2 and lower.
records.repoBenefit: Use Mind Trick on beasts with Intelligence 2 or less; they cannot perform or understand complex directions.
records.repoDescription: You may use Mind Trick on beasts with Intelligence 2 or lower.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Control|Force Suppression
records.canonicalTreeKey: Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Control
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: If you use the rebuke Force power to attempt to negate or redirect a Force power used against you but fail to overcome your opponent's Use the Force check result, you instead lessen the effect of the Force power by one step. For example, if an opponent attempted to use the slow Force power on you and rolled a 21, if you fail to rebuke the power you only suffer the DC 15 effect instead of the DC 20 effect. This talent only affects Force powers that have variable effects based on your opponent's Use the Force checks, and powers with static DCs without variable effects (such as Force lightning) are unaffected.
records.quickSummary: If you use the rebuke Force power to attempt to negate or redirect a Force power used against you but fail to overcome your opponent's Use the Force check result, you instead lessen the effect of the Force power by one step.
records.repoBenefit: Attempt to rebuke a Force power; if you fail, lessen its effect by one step; only works on powers with variable effects.
records.repoDescription: Rebuke a Force power; on a failed rebuke, reduce its effect.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey|Action Exchange
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: Whenever you successfully use Force Delay, you grant one ally within six squares and line of sight the ability to trade a move action for another standard action on his next turn.
records.quickSummary: Whenever you successfully use Force Delay, you grant one ally within six squares and line of sight the ability to trade a move action for another standard action on his next turn.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey|Force Delay
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: Jal Shey verbally startle opponents with a little help from the Force. Once per encounter, make a Persuasion check against the Will Defense of a target of Intelligence 3 or higher that can understand you as a reaction. If successful, the target loses its move action on its next round. If you spend a Force Point, the target loses its standard action instead.
records.quickSummary: Jal Shey verbally startle opponents with a little help from the Force.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey|Imbue Item
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You can spend a Force Point to imbue a specially crafted weapon, item, armor, or article of clothing with the power of the Force. Imbuing the item requires a full round action. As a full-round action, the wearer of such an item can open himself to the Force, transferring one of their Force Points into the item. You can then use a swift action to spend a stored Force Point at any later time, even in the same round that you spend a Force Point of your own. You can attune only one item per 24 hours, the item functions only for you and a given item can only store one Force Point at a time. You cannot wear more than one attuned item at a time, and you can spend only up to a maximum of two Force Points in a round (one of your own plus one from an item).
records.quickSummary: You can spend a Force Point to imbue a specially crafted weapon, item, armor, or article of clothing with the power of the Force.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey|Knowledge of the Force
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Jal Shey
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You can use your scholarly knowledge of the Force to help others reach their full potential. You can spend a Force Point as a reaction to aid another ally within 6 squares on a Use the Force check, following the normal rules for the aid another action as usual.
records.quickSummary: You can use your scholarly knowledge of the Force to help others reach their full potential.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael|Conceal Force Use
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You have learned to use the Force without telltale gestures, reducing the disturbance created in the process. Whenever you make a Use the Force check, as a swift action you can make a Deception check to convey deceptive appearances in order to conceal the effects of your Force use. Normal modifiers for the deception’s complexity still apply.
records.quickSummary: You have learned to use the Force without telltale gestures, reducing the disturbance created in the process.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael|Force Direction
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You use the Force to guide your ranged attacks to their target. Whenever you spend a Force point to add to a ranged attack roll, you can always add +3 (or +4, if you roll d8s for Force Points) instead of rolling the die.
records.quickSummary: You use the Force to guide your ranged attacks to their target.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael|Force Momentum
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You use the Force to add to the impact of your melee weapon, increasing your damage. Whenever you spend a Force point to add to a melee attack roll, if the attack hits you can also add the Force point’s result to the damage roll.
records.quickSummary: You use the Force to add to the impact of your melee weapon, increasing your damage.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael|Past Visions
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Keetael
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: The long-lived Draethos are particularly adept at searching and understanding the past. When using farseeing to look into the past, reduce your DC numbers by half. Also, you are able to see everything within 6 squares of your target clearly without spending a Force Point.
records.quickSummary: The long-lived Draethos are particularly adept at searching and understanding the past.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath|Dark Side Manipulation
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: Your Sith sorcery experimentation has provided you with a method of manipulating the dark side. Once per encounter, when using a Force Point in an act that would give you a dark side point, you may treat the Force Point as though you had rolled the maximum on the die.
records.quickSummary: Your Sith sorcery experimentation has provided you with a method of manipulating the dark side.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath|Krath Illusions
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: As a swift action, you can reduce the penalty for large illusions by one half (rounded down, minimum -1).
records.quickSummary: As a swift action, you can reduce the penalty for large illusions by one half (rounded down, minimum -1).

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath|Krath Intuition
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You have a natural ability to use dark-side artifacts, such as Sith talismans and alchemical weapons. Once per encounter, you may spend a Force Point to treat the damage from a Sith alchemical weapon as though you had rolled the maximum damage on the dice.
records.quickSummary: You have a natural ability to use dark-side artifacts, such as Sith talismans and alchemical weapons.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath|Krath Surge
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Krath
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, using rudimentary Sith sorcery, you channel dark side energy in a manner that boosts one use of a Force power. As a swift action, you can add 1 die of damage (if the power deals damage) or extend the range of the power by 6 squares (if it has a range beyond yourself or a single target). Using this talent automatically adds the [dark side] descriptor to the power used.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, using rudimentary Sith sorcery, you channel dark side energy in a manner that boosts one use of a Force power.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene|Field Detection
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: As a swift action, make a DC 15 Use the Force check. If tne check succeeds, you can detect the presence, general strength, and origin (or direction of origin if the source is out of range) of electromagnetic and energy fields within 12 squares of you. You can also determine the type of field, allowing you to detect communications devices, sensors, and other electronic equipment. When dealing damage to a person or droid using a personal shield, or to a vehicle with shields active, a successful check allows you to detect minute fluctuations in the shield, reducing their SR by -5 against your attacks until the end of your turn.
records.quickSummary: As a swift action, make a DC 15 Use the Force check.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene|Improved Force Sight
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: Your natural Force sight is more precise than that of your fellow Miraluka. You can use the Search application of the Perception skill as a swift action. Additionally, you always succeed when using the Sense Surroundings application of the Use the Force skill (no roll required).
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Force sight species trait, trained in Use the Force
records.quickSummary: Your natural Force sight is more precise than that of your fellow Miraluka.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene|Luka Sene Master
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You are a master of Luka Sene techniques and an expert in using sense-related talents and powers. Once per encounter, you gain a temporary Force Point that you must spend when activating a talent from the Sense or Luka Sene talent trees, using the farseeing Force power, or on a Use the Force check made to use the Search Your Feelings or Sense Force applications of the skill. The Force Point is lost if not used before the end of the encounter.
records.quickSummary: You are a master of Luka Sene techniques and an expert in using sense-related talents and powers.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene|Quickseeing
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Luka Sene
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: As a free action on your turn, you can make a Use the Force check against a living creature within 12 squares, removing one use of the farseeing Force power from your active suite (as though you had activated the power). If your check result equals or exceeds the Will Defense of the target you gain a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls against that target until the end of your turn. This counts as using the farseeing Force power against that target, but this talent replaces the normal rules and effect of that power.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Trained in Use the Force, farseeing
records.quickSummary: As a free action on your turn, you can make a Use the Force check against a living creature within 12 squares, removing one use of the farseeing Force power from your active suite (as though you had activated the power).

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa|Deception Awareness
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: Realizing how the devastating the consequences would have been if the Sith had successfully deceived her and her companions during the Jedi Civil War, Shasa has developed a technique for using the Force to detect deceptions. You gain +5 to your Will Defense against uses of the Deception skill. Additionally, you can make a Use the Force check instead of a Perception check to sense deception and sense influence. You are considered trained in Perception for the purpose of using this talent. If you are entitled toa Perception check reroll, you may reroll your Use the Force check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations).
records.quickSummary: Realizing how the devastating the consequences would have been if the Sith had successfully deceived her and her companions during the Jedi Civil War, Shasa has developed a technique for using the Force to detect deceptions.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa|Greater Weapon Focus (Fira)
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You have mastered the chosen weapon of the Order of Shasa. You gain a +1 bonus on melee attack rolls with a fira. This bonus stacks with the bonus granted by the Weapon Focus feat.
records.quickSummary: You have mastered the chosen weapon of the Order of Shasa.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa|Progenitor's Call
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: You have learned to sense the call of your ancestors and wield it through the Force. Once per encounter, you can telepathically disrupt an enemy by making a Use the Force check against the target's Will Defense. If you succeed, the target is confused by the call, moving -1 persistent step down the condition track and losing its standard action on its next turn. A creature can only be affected by this power once per encounter, and the persistent condition can be removed with a DC 15 Treat Injury check or by resting for 8 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect.
records.quickSummary: You have learned to sense the call of your ancestors and wield it through the Force.

records.canonicalIdentity: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa|Waveform
records.canonicalTreeKey: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide|Order of Shasa
records.sourcebook: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide
records.canonicalDescription: Taking cues from Manaan's oceans, you know how to emulate wave action using the Force. As a swift action, when you use a telekinetic Force power (that is, a power affected by the Telekinetic Power or Telekinetic Savant talents), you manipulate the particles of the environment around you to add to the force of impact, allowing you to add your Charisma modifier to any damage dealt (minimum +1).
records.quickSummary: Taking cues from Manaan's oceans, you know how to emulate wave action using the Force.
